SB Rides LED Night Ride

Shreveport, LA · Downtown · Cruiser · Social

Beginner friendly

SB Rides LED Night Ride is a cruiser and social group ride in Shreveport, LA. Schedule: Select evenings, roughly every week or two in summer, 8:00 pm; dates on Instagram, from J.O.S.H. Lounge, downtown Shreveport. Pace: casual. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @sb_rides the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the SB Rides LED Night Ride group ride

A two-hour night cruise on LED-lit beach cruisers through downtown Shreveport with a couple of bar stops. Built for people who do not own a bike or have not ridden in years. Ages 21 and up. Dates are posted a few weeks at a time.
